investment_theses.thesis: Geopolitical risk premium in crude oil and macro uncertainty will compress crypto valuations vs. equities through Q2 2026, creating tactical BTC/gold upside as safe-haven rotation.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Crypto under weekend pressure, Bitcoin slides below $80K on U.S. Middle East evacuations.
CNBC: Iran threat warnings intensify ahead of midterms; American embassies tighten security.
Cointelegraph: Brent crude hits highest level since March; Bitcoin seeks support above $81K.
CNBC: French unrest and 24-year bond yield highs signal systemic credit stress.
investment_theses.counter_view: Safe-haven flows may preferentially favor U.S. Treasuries and dollar strength (DXY rally), crowding out BTC as geopolitical hedge if U.S. is seen as safest harbor.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC/USD spot or June 2026 BTC perps; pair trade BTC vs. DXY (short DXY). Alt: Gold vs. BTC ratio (short GLD/BTC).

investment_theses.thesis: Aerospace/aviation supply-chain stress (early aircraft scrapping, engine/parts scarcity) will drive outperformance in specialized parts OEMs and aftermarket suppliers through 2026–27.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Airplanes dismantled for parts years ahead of schedule because engines and components in short supply.
Implicit sector tailwind: Airlines forced into scarcity premium purchasing, supporting margin for Tier-1 and Tier-2 suppliers.
investment_theses.counter_view: Supply chains normalize faster than expected; geopolitical easing reduces demand uncertainty; major OEMs (Rolls-Royce, Safran) expand output and compress pricing.
investment_theses.expression: Long aerospace/defense ETF (ITA); tactical overweight Rolls-Royce or Safran ADR if European exposure desired. Alt: Long airline puts (sector hedges) if pair-trading into supply-chain plays.

investment_theses.thesis: SEC and regulatory push against tokenized securities (flagged as 2027 high-risk exam area; major bank objections to OKX-ICE) will compress near-term sentiment for crypto-finance infrastructure but create longer-dated regulatory clarity premium.
supporting_signals: Cointelegraph: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations.
CoinDesk & Cointelegraph: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell objecting to OKX-ICE tokenized stock plan.
CoinDesk: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia and Middle East competitive edge.
Cointelegraph: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties for crypto (regulatory softening signal).
investment_theses.counter_view: Regulatory crackdown accelerates and becomes punitive rather than clarifying; tokenization stalls entirely in U.S. market; offshore venues capture all flow.
investment_theses.expression: Tactical short crypto infrastructure tokens (exchanges, settlement platforms); strategic long Ethereum ETF or Solana (beneficiary of offshore adoption). Alt: Long Hong Kong or Singapore crypto-friendly ETFs.

investment_theses.thesis: Biotech equity upside driven by Amgen lung-cancer drug efficacy (58% risk-of-death reduction) and Vanessa Trump cancer-free narrative will compress valuations in overleveraged neo-cloud infrastructure plays, creating sector rotation into healthcare.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Amgen drug combo cuts risk of death by 58% in aggressive lung cancer; breakthrough efficacy.
BBC: Vanessa Trump announces cancer-free status 6 months post-diagnosis; positive sentiment for oncology-adjacent narratives.
CNBC: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces first big test as neoclouds take market hit.
Implicit: Healthcare outperformance relative to mega-cap AI infrastructure.
investment_theses.counter_view: Amgen drug approval timelines slip; neoclouds rebound on strong unit economics and continued capex cycles; sector rotation reverses.
investment_theses.expression: Long XBI (Biotech ETF) or XLV (Healthcare) vs. short NVDA or Magnificent 7 tech. Alt: Long Amgen calls; pair vs. short Palantir or other AI infrastructure plays.

investment_theses.thesis: Mature bitcoin holder behavior (loans, yield strategies) and Berkshire narrative reset (all-time highs post-Buffett transition) will drive institutional adoption of BTC treasury strategies, creating sustained bid under $80K through mid-2026.
